Product details

Save a listing only after the details make sense.

A practical product-level checklist before opening a live FindSpreadsheet result.

1. Identify the exact version

Compare product name, visible options, colour and size. Similar listings are not necessarily the same product.

2. Check decision-critical information

For clothing, compare measurements and material context. For accessories or electronics, inspect essential functional details.

3. Prepare QC questions

List only photos or measurements that would change your decision before choosing packaging or shipping.
